name: Align T1 to ACPC Plane (HCP-based)
summary: Aligns a T1-weighted image to the ACPC plane with a 6-DOF rigid FSL alignment (flirt, aff2rigid) to the MNI152 T1 1mm template, following the HCP pipelines, with optional reorientation, cropping and template masking.
description: Optionally reorients (fslreorient2std) and crops the neck (robustfov), estimates an affine registration to the template (MNI152 or NIHPD) with flirt, reduces it to a rigid-body (6 DOF) transform with aff2rigid and resamples the T1w with spline interpolation. Use it to put a T1w image in a standard ACPC orientation before FreeSurfer or other anatomical processing; it does not warp the brain to the template shape. Set mask to true for skull-stripped inputs so the template is masked too.

inputs.description: The path to the anat/t1w datatype to be aligned

outputs.description: Rigid (6 DOF) affine matrix (affine.txt) mapping the input T1w to the ACPC-aligned template space.

parameters.description: This controls whether the datatype of the app is T1 or T2. Not to be changed, used in order to keep the code same between T1 and T2

This template is used to align the input image to standard MNI orientation (acpc aligned). For adult brain, MNI152 should work fine, however, if you have pediatric images please select a template with correct age group in order to ensure that your input image will better align with the template. Otherwise, flirt will fail to correctly align your image.
If true, will reorient image to FSL standard using fslreorient2std
If true, will crop using FSL robustfov
if input data is already brain masked, set this to true to mask out the template
